scope: Prediction only. No task/plan success evaluation, training, simulation, search or threshold changes.
step_unit: one complete recorded skill call, including a refused request; never one low-level control frame
recursive_definition: Encode only real initial observation; recursively apply logged actions to predicted latent; no real-observation correction.
strict_correctness: all9 propositions exactly match true labels; existing0.5 threshold for first6 and drawer3 argmax. All9 must be valid.
main_cohorts: All complete4-skill reference sequences (5 expected), and separately all recorded matching-arm first4-skill streams containing a refusal (10 expected). Do not pool the two policies/overlapping roots. No selection by prediction correctness.
coverage: Report original12 reference roots and12 logged streams; preserve failed/unreached and original3-step sequences. Also show all-available horizons with variable denominators as supplementary only.
cumulative: Correct at every step1..h, excluding initial state accuracy from this definition.
real_readout_control: Encode each real successor through the same frozen query; reuse the corresponding saved probabilities. Does not feed into recursive trajectory.
error_groups: Count states with any erroneous Holding / In / drawer proposition per horizon; groups can overlap. Also retain per-proposition FP/FN.
